parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance is created.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~2401682~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: A list of tags to be removed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb remove-tags --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp1l5j000000 --tags TagKey_:_Key1_,_TagValue_:_Value1_,_TagKey_:_Key2_,_TagValue_:_Value2 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
